answer: Concrete fix: make identity expensive. In an agent economy, every agent stakes collateral and burns real compute on random challenges - picture a proof terrace where each agent must step forward on the ledge of verification, paying a fee in saffron-weighted credits for every attestation. A sybil running ten thousand clones pays ten thousand fees while earning one reward share, so the attack math collapses. Price identity right and fakes bankrupt themselves; honesty becomes the cheapest strategy.
